boundaries: Same browser context and network partition; loopback HTTP/1.1 origin.
First navigation, warmed HTTP reads and first-page reload are reported separately.
PNG fetch queue and image decode elapsed intervals are separate; decode intervals include asynchronous wait and CPU, rather than measuring decoder CPU alone.
Audio/video duration and codecs are synthetic; actual user media metadata was outside the non-content read scope.
No foreground browser or user canvas operations.
